lines.beaver: 와, 냄새 좋다! 해물전 다 됐어?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, smells great! Is the seafood pancake done?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, naemsae jota! haemuljeon da dwaesseo?
lines.learner: 응, 다 됐어. 내가 이걸 만들었다니!
lines.en: Yeah, it's done. I can't believe I made this!
lines.roman: eung, da dwaesseo. naega igeol mandeureotdani!

lines.beaver_en: Was the seafood fresh? Or frozen?
lines.en: It was frozen. I thawed it by soaking it in salt water.

lines.beaver_en: Good job. Did you peel all the shrimp?
lines.learner: 응, 새우를 까고 오징어는 잘게 다졌어.
lines.en: Yes, I peeled the shrimp and minced the squid.
lines.roman: eung, saeureul kkago ojingeoneun jalge dajeosseo.

lines.en: I added pumpkin and a little pancake powder.

lines.beaver_en: How did you make the sauce?
lines.en: I put a little sesame oil in soy sauce.

lines.beaver_en: How was the heat? Didn't it burn?
lines.learner: 식용유를 두르고 약한 불로 잘 익혔어.
lines.en: I used cooking oil and cooked it on low heat.
lines.roman: sigyongnyureul dureugo yakan bullo jal ikyeosseo.

lines.beaver: 한번 먹어 볼게. 음, 진짜 맛있다!
lines.beaver_en: Let me try. Mmm, it's really good!
lines.beaver_roman: hanbeon meogeo bolge. eum, jinjja masitda!
lines.learner: 정말? 처음 만든 요리가 이렇게 맛있다니!
lines.en: Really? My first dish is this tasty?!
lines.roman: jeongmal? cheoeum mandeun yoriga ireoke masitdani!

lines.en: No, it only took thirty minutes.

lines.beaver_en: Is there something to drink too?
lines.en: Yes, I boiled barley tea and let it cool.

lines.beaver: 아이고, 너 이제 요리사다! 또 해 줘.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, you're a chef now! Make it again.
lines.beaver_roman: aigo, neo ije yorisada! tto hae jwo.
lines.en: Sure! Next time I'll try making strawberry jam.
